concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-gift-cards-ios-drop-in]] — 2025-modified, 2026-09-15-captured iOS Drop-in gift-card guide: /sessions no extra method integration, /payments partial-payment delegate, async result and provider-dependent test/live setup.
warnings: The no-required-integration statement applies to gift-card-specific /sessions additions, not base iOS Drop-in or account setup.
/payments Swift code is a placeholder delegate example, not a complete balance/order API implementation.
Test amount suffixes are simulator cases; live acceptance requires provider onboarding, live variant addition and Support setup.
